item.title: Eyre Highway marks 50 years since final section was sealed
item.description: Some travellers still remember crossing the Nullarbor on the unsealed road with bumps, breakdowns, and floods all part of the journey. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Holmes and Claire Moodie

item.title: Breaking: Knights star sent to NRL judiciary for tackle that broke Cleary's leg
item.description: Phoenix Crossland must argue his case at the NRL judiciary if he is any chance of playing in the grand final after he was cited for the hip drop that broke Nathan Cleary's leg. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Ireland refuses handshake with Israel, wears black armbands for game
item.description: Players from the Republic of Ireland wear black armbands, bow their heads during the Israeli anthem and refuse handshakes during a Nations League football match. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Darwin hip hop artist Yung Milla wins The Voice Australia
item.description: Northern Territory hip hop artist Yung Milla is crowned the winner of The Voice Australia, with many fans resonating with the artist's candid telling of his difficult upbringing and his pride for his Aboriginal culture. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Grace Atta, Liz Trevaskis, and Tilda Colling

item.title: Union not told Victorian paramedics to take lead on mental health call-outs
item.description: The Victorian Ambulance Union says it has found out about a government plan to make paramedics the first responders to mental health call-outs through the media. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Melissa Brown

item.title: South Korea demands Ukraine apologise for revealing POW transfer
item.description: Seoul accuses Ukraine of announcing the transfer of North Korean soldiers caught fighting for Russia to South Korea in breach of a non-disclosure agreement. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Morning kayakers treated to rare dolphin sighting in Sydney Harbour
item.description: A pod of about 10 dolphins delights kayakers in Sydney Harbour this morning, with one kayak tour operator saying it's rare to see the animals that far west. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Declan Bowring

item.title: Marchers condemn violence, remember lost community members
item.description: Latrobe Valley families unite in a peace march to condemn violence a year on from a teenager's death Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Bec Symons

item.title: Coach goes viral after smearing player's blood on own face
item.description: College football coach PJ Fleck is described as "crazy" after smearing the blood of one his player's onto his own face after their team's US college football victory. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australian middle order collapses again as South Africa claims ODI
item.description: Mitch Marsh and Travis Head pile on the runs in their opening partnership, but the middle order fails again in South Africa. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Birrell claims long awaited WTA title, but loses top Aussie ranking
item.description: Kim Birrell downs compatriot Maya Joint to claim her first WTA title, but loses her number one ranking as another Australian performs well in Singapore. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia news live: Chalmers and Gallagher to present final budget outcome; RBA interest rate hike looms
item.description: Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Gallagher says final budget outcome will show $6bn improvement Gallagher and treasurer Jim Chalmers are set to present the final budget outcome today, which she said will show about a $6bn improvement since the federal budget. We do everything we can to make sure that the budget is in as good a shape as it can, acknowledging that we are having to find room to invest in all these areas that the Australian people care about deeply and want to see improved services in. I think this incident really adds weight… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Flood victims wait four years for repairs to homes
item.description: Flood-affected residents have been waiting nearly four years to get their homes repaired or even rebuilt due to a severe tradesperson shortage. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Amelia Walters

item.title: Men accused of planning terrorist attack near RAF base used to strike Iran
item.description: Five men are suspected of preparing a terrorist act near an English air base the United States is using to strike Iranian targets. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Luke Cooper

item.title: Young Arrernte boxer sets sights on Olympics after AIS opportunity
item.description: Twelve-year-old Leela Lord has returned from a national Indigenous boxing camp at the Australian Institute of Sport with bigger ambitions for her future in the ring. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Treasurer to unveil $6 billion improvement to federal budget
item.description: Jim Chalmers will today unveil a $6 billion improvement to the federal government's forecast deficit. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Wall Street closes higher, ASX lacks direction ahead of rates decision
item.description: Wall Street closed a volatile week on an upbeat note, but the ASX remains under pressure. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Emergency services were called to a Fernvale street after reports a man had been struck by a vehicle. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Emergency services were called to a Fernvale street after reports a man had been struck by a vehicle. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Two dead, one critical following crash in Victoria's north-west
item.description: Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding a crash that has left two people dead and a third person critically injured. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'People were on the floor': Patient's 23-hour wait at Sydney hospital
item.description: Adnaan spent 23 hours on a hard chair at Sydney's Westmead Hospital before leaving without a bed. New figures show he is not alone. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: A month after Nepal's floods, husband still hopes his wife can be found
item.description: A month on from the devastating Nepal flash floods, a Newcastle man is urging the international community not to give up searching for those missing. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Nathan Cleary requires surgery on both feet after horrific NRL preliminary final injury
item.description: An emotional Ivan Cleary explains his star son's right foot had been broken before he suffered a horror compound fracture to his left ankle. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: SA's statewide blackout was 10 years ago — but electricity debate is still live
item.description: Energy policy has changed greatly since South Australia was left in darkness exactly 10 years ago today — but if there is a universal constant of the energy debate, it is that there is always friction over electricity. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Keane

item.title: Nullarbor caves might hold secrets about life on Mars, research suggests
item.description: Underground caves beneath South Australia's Nullarbor Plain could have the answer to finding life on Mars, according to new research. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tom Mann, Isabella Kelly, and Emma Pedler

item.title: Get rules in place to hold data centres to account, experts tell Tasmania
item.description: An artificial intelligence institute warns there may not be much economic benefit from data centre developments if public authorities don't put binding conditions on proponents. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Shannon felt a ‘sense of doom’ as she sought justice for sexual assault. A new NSW program hopes to alleviate that
item.description: Exclusive: Dedicated service to support sexual assault victim-survivors as they navigate legal system to open in NSW Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast It took Shannon Stokes two years and 11 days to successfully prosecute her former boyfriend for sexual assault and domestic violence offences. The lengthy trial left her feeling as though “there wasn’t going to be an end in sight”. Prosecutors secured convictions on nine of the 11 charges, and he was later sentenced to five years in prison. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Achol Arok

item.title: NI qualifying for World Cup 'surreal' - O'Hanlon
item.description: Northern Ireland netball vice-captain Caroline O'Hanlon says "not many outside of our camp expected us to qualify" after the booked their spot in the 2027 World Cup in Australia. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Soon-to-be empty nester wants to rent out rooms but put off by tax
item.description: In some countries, homeowners can take in boarders with a tax-free threshold to incentivise renting out spare rooms. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Gloomy forecast for south-east Queensland before skies clear again

item.title: Serious NDIS complaints languishing as regulator grapples with backlog
item.description: NDIS participants say serious reports of abuse, neglect and fraud are languishing as internal data reveals the regulator is grappling with a significant backlog of complaints. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Forty years after whaling was banned, threats remain
item.description: Since whaling was banned in 1986, whale numbers have rebounded but threats, mostly human-made, remain and are on the agenda at a meeting in Hobart. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Ambulance service only fully meets 17 per cent of safety and quality standards
item.description: An ambulance service wanted to see if it could meet national safety and quality standards, but in a mock assessment, only fully met 17 per cent of actions — a result described as "diabolical" by a paramedics' union. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
